headline: Brazil Adopts New Rules to Curb Excessive Household Indebtedness
summary: Brazil's National Monetary Council and Central Bank approved a set of measures establishing stricter criteria for granting loans and expanding consumer protections to curb household debt.
why: Regulatory interventions in consumer credit aim to reduce systemic financial risks and stabilize non-performing loan ratios across the banking sector.

impacts.name: Brazilian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Stricter lending criteria directly affect retail credit generation by commercial banks.
